test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The heights of six students in a school are 160 cm, 175 cm, 142 cm, 136 cm, 148 cm and 182 cm. Find the mean (in cm) of their heights (round off to 2 decimal places).
solution:
**Given:**

Heights of six students: 160 cm, 175 cm, 142 cm, 136 cm, 148 cm, 182 cm.

**Formula Used:**

Mean = (Sum of all values) / (Number of values)

**Calculation:**

Sum of heights = 160 + 175 + 142 + 136 + 148 + 182

Sum of heights = 943 cm

Number of students = 6

Mean = 943 / 6

Mean = 157.1667

Rounded to two decimal places: 157.17 cm

**The mean height of the students is 157.17 cm.**
